content: .claude-plugin/ dir contains ONLY plugin.json. All other dirs (commands/, agents/, skills/, hooks/, workflows/, output-styles/, themes/, monitors/) live at plugin root, sibling to .claude-plugin/. hooks/hooks.json for hook config, .mcp.json and .lsp.json at root for MCP/LSP, bin/ for executables added to PATH. CLAUDE.md at plugin root is NOT loaded as context -- must use a skill instead. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} env var for portable paths in scripts/hooks; ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} for persistent state across updates. Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference (fetched directly).
